services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of QLD coal saleable tonnes, Pilbara Ports iron ore, mining capex, commodity prices and metres drilled against their own trailing 5-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -27.5 on 31 July 2026, it is below its 5-year norm, having fallen from -12.2 a month earlier and 28.9 six months earlier. QLD coal saleable tonnes is the biggest negative contributor (-22.1), while ABS metres drilled is the biggest positive (+4.1).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 22.6 in August 2026, it is above its five-year norm; it has eased from 25.6 a month earlier but remains well above its May and February readings. US new orders for iron and steel mills are the biggest positive contributor (+33.3), while inverted AUD/USD is the biggest negative (-23.3); two inputs have no data yet.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of fitter/welder vacancy tightness, AUD/USD and tungsten policy flags against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -22.9 in August 2026, it is below its five-year norm; it improved from -32.2 three months earlier but slipped from -15.9 last month. AUD/USD is the largest negative contributor (-35.0), while fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the largest positive (+12.1); tungsten policy flags have no data yet.
